name: Vespiquen
description: Commands its subjects to build its hive. It will dispatch any interlopers who dare sneak into its nest and use them as nourishment for itself.

moves.name: Gust
moves.description: A gust of wind is whipped up by wings and launched at the target to inflict damage.

moves.name: Struggle Bug
moves.description: The user struggles against the target, dealing damage. This also lowers the target's offensive stats.

moves.name: Pin Missile
moves.description: Sharp spikes are shot at the target. Spike splinters left behind by this attack continue to damage the target for several turns.

moves.name: Silver Wind
moves.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

moves.name: Slash
moves.description: The target is attacked with a slash of claws or blades. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Air Slash
moves.description: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky.

moves.name: Power Gem
moves.description: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.

moves.name: Bug Buzz
moves.description: The user vibrates to generate a damaging sound wave. This may also lower the target’s defensive stats.

moves.name: Recover
moves.description: The user regenerates its cells to restore its own HP.
